### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: E&F's own common/company_types/00_ef_companies.txt -- all 97
### of its bank companies.
###
### Two things per company, both INJECT: so nothing E&F wrote is overridden --
### its building list, its prosperity modifier and its existing prestige goods
### (manufacture_stock_gbr and the like) stay exactly as they are.
###
### building_bank: E&F keeps `#building_bank` commented out in every one of them.
### It could not have worked before -- the building was no_ownership and its group
### government funded, so no company could hold it. zz_ef_cm_bank.txt fixes that.
###
### All 95 prestige currencies in every company, because company -> country is not
### derivable from the files: 6 of 103 companies name a tag, the rest go by
### interest markers. The currency law behind each prestige good does the picking
### instead -- see zz_ef_cm_prestige_currencies.txt.
